sections.title: 5.3.3 Microscopic Findings
sections.text: Microscopic examination was performed on all animals. Thyroid follicular cell hypertrophy, grade 1, was present in Group 3 (90 mg/kg/day) in 2 of 10 animals and Group 4 (300 mg/kg/day) in 3 of 10 animals. No follicular cell hyperplasia, no necrosis, and no macroscopic thyroid correlate were observed. No other treatment-related findings were identified.

sections.title: 5.3.4 Conclusion
sections.text: No adverse treatment-related findings were identified at any dose level tested. The no-observed-adverse-effect level (NOAEL) for Compound HX-063 is **300 mg/kg/day**, the highest dose tested. No lowest-observed-adverse-effect level (LOAEL) was established. The thyroid follicular cell hypertrophy observed at 90 and 300 mg/kg/day is considered an adaptive response to increased hepatic thyroxine clearance and is not considered adverse based on: (1) absence of follicular cell hyperplasia or necrosis; (2) absence of a macroscopic thyroid correlate; (3) minimal severity grade and low incidence.
